_note: Which write conditions each VFS honours, per operation, for write: conditional. put = PutObject If-Match; create = PutObject If-None-Match: *; copy = CopyObject If-Match / If-None-Match: * / x-amz-copy-source-if-match; delete = DeleteObject If-Match and the DeleteObjects per-key ETag. A VFS with no op cannot mount conditional. Both hosts' WRITE_CONDITIONS must equal this table, and it must name every registered VFS.

_evidence.s3: measured: AWS S3 us-west-2, 2026-10-04 (put, create, copy If-Match, multipart, delete If-Match) and 2026-10-06 (copy If-None-Match, CopySourceIfMatch, DeleteObjects ETag)
